Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

name: arc-u-frame-ray
description: Use when an ARC grid has a 5-colored three-sided rectangular frame open on its top edge. Fill its interior with 2 and extend a 2 bar leftward from the opening row.
---

# ARC: open-top frame with leftward ray

## Recognition
Look for one or more 5-colored, approximately rectangular U-shaped frames: vertical sides and a bottom edge, with a gap in the top edge. In known instances, the interior is a 2x2 region and the top edge has two adjacent 5s followed by a one-cell opening, then the right wall.

## Transformation
For each qualifying frame:
1. Preserve all 5 cells.
2. Recolor the empty interior cells to 2.
3. On the row immediately above the frame's top edge, color cells 2 from the left grid boundary through the column of the top-edge opening, inclusive. Preserve all other cells.
4. Apply the same independently to every frame in the grid.

## Evidence and caution
This rule was demonstrated on one example and confirmed on a test with two frames. The frames can be at different locations. Verify orientation and output dimensions; do not extend the bar if the detected frame does not match the open-top pattern.",
